scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:client && npm run test:backend && npm run test:admin
scripts.typecheck:frontend: cd frontend && npx tsc -b && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:client: cd client && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.build:admin: if [ -d admin ]; then cd admin && npm run build; else echo 'skipping admin build (admin/ not present)'; fi
scripts.test:admin: if [ -d admin ]; then cd admin && npx vitest run; else echo 'skipping admin tests (admin/ not present)'; fi
scripts.lint:admin: if [ -d admin ]; then cd admin && npm run lint; else echo 'skipping admin lint (admin/ not present)'; fi
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:client && npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:admin
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uvx ruff check lambdas --exclude .aws-sam && uvx ruff format --check lambdas --exclude .aws-sam
scripts.lint:docs:links: command -v lychee >/dev/null 2>&1 && lychee --config lychee.toml "docs/**/*.md" "*.md" "admin/*.md" "client/README.md" "client/electron-resources/README.md" "mock-linkedin/README.md" ".github/workflows/README.md" "frontend/src/features/legal/documents/*.md" "backend/docs-api/index.md" ".agents/workflows/*.md" || echo 'lychee not installed locally; link checking runs in CI via lycheeverse/lychee-action. Install: https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee#installation'
scripts.docs:api:ts: cd frontend && npx typedoc --out ../docs/api/ts/frontend && cd ../client && npx typedoc --out ../docs/api/ts/client && cd .. && if [ -d admin ]; then cd admin && npx typedoc --out ../docs/api/ts/admin; else echo 'skipping admin typedoc (admin/ not present)'; fi
scripts.docs:api:py: cd backend && uvx --with "mkdocstrings[python]>=0.26" --with mkdocs-material --with mkdocs-gen-files --with mkdocs-literate-nav --from mkdocs mkdocs build
scripts.docs:api: npm run docs:api:ts && npm run docs:api:py
scripts.format:admin: if [ -d admin ]; then npx prettier --write 'admin/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'; else echo 'skipping admin format (admin/ not present)'; fi
scripts.format:check:admin: if [ -d admin ]; then npx prettier --check 'admin/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'; else echo 'skipping admin format check (admin/ not present)'; fi
scripts.typecheck:admin: if [ -d admin ]; then cd admin && npx tsc -b && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit; else echo 'skipping admin typecheck (admin/ not present)'; fi
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:client && npm run typecheck:admin && npm run typecheck:backend && npm run test
